project.name: Desk lamp (golden path)
project.description: A low voltage, USB-C powered, dimmable desktop lamp: printable base, curved arm and head, LED module, diffuser and a driver/control board. The multidisciplinary golden path across CAD, EDA, firmware, simulation and manufacturing. Seeded from examples/desk_lamp.

prompt: Design a modern desktop lamp with adjustable brightness, a compact base, a curved arm and a soft diffuser. Make it suitable for 3D printing.

references.title: The lamp's product definition
references.note: The written brief this example seeds from. Text only.

references.title: A photo or sketch of a lamp you like
references.note: Omitted on purpose: no reference image ships with the example, and none is faked. Add your own in Create and choose its role.

intended_use.value: A modern desktop lamp for reading and desk work, with adjustable brightness. Powered over USB-C at 5 V (low voltage, no mains).

appearance.value: Compact base, a curved arm and a soft, even light through a diffuser.

making_context.value: Suitable for 3D printing: base, arm and head shell printed by FDM; driver/control board made by a PCB fabricator.

materials.value: Diffuser in a translucent material (assumed: translucent PETG). Printed parts in PLA or PETG (assumed).

success_criteria.value: A traceable, revision-compatible prototype manufacturing package: print files, PCB fabrication files, BOM, firmware build and assembly instructions that belong to the same revision.

measurements.label: Base footprint (width)
measurements.note: Approximate; the parametric CAD sets the real value.

measurements.label: Curved arm length along the curve
Driver/control board width
measurements.note: Approximate; the PCB layout sets the real value.

assumptions.text: Low voltage only: 5 V from USB-C. Electrical and product-safety review is still required.
The diffuser is printed in a translucent material (translucent PETG) until a person chooses otherwise.
The brightness control is a button or a rotary encoder; not decided yet.

intended_use.value: Desktop lighting, indoors, dimmable, powered over USB-C at 5 V (low voltage)

selected_process.note: Base, arm and head shell are 3D printed.

assembly.value: Screws into printed bosses and snap fits

selected_material.note: Any translucent printable material that spreads the light evenly.

concept_assembly.title: Desk lamp concept assembly
concept_assembly.rationale: The lamp's parts as the product definition names them, so each part has a stable component id from the start. Sizes are estimates until the CAD and the PCB layout exist.

connections.joint: pivot, M3 screw into a printed boss
